notes.title: Update v1.1
notes.content:
Highlights from the update include:

-New levels and simulations, including a new and terrifying encounter with two Allosaurus 
-The addition of new features in existing levels

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33884507/1d01a152d0ad096202596390e7db0e77edd2a8db.jpg

notes.title: Update v1.09
notes.content:
Now with new dinosaurs, animals, weapons and missions. There are well over 10 missions to choose from with: 

-different environments such as sparse and dense forests, high and low grass areas, research facilities, waterways, inside helicopters and armoured vehicles. 

-large open areas to freely explore and find weapons in either daylight or at night (if you are brave enough). 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33884507/cfe5085421a420183d865950aa17da557d3ba54a.jpg

notes.title: Update v1.08
notes.content:
Highlights from the update include:

-Multiple new levels including a terrifying encounter with an Allosaurus 
-Small improvements to sound, resolution and VR immersion
-Small new features in existing levels

notes.title: Update V1.06
notes.content:
Highlights from the update include:
-A raptor chase simulation level 
-Small improvements to the main menu 
-Improvements to game clarity and resolution settings

New levels, weapons, animals, dinosaurs and improvements to navigation will be released in the next few updates.
